title: Headline sales exclude GST
statement: The headline sales value on dashboards and for agents is the value excluding GST, after discount.

title: Retail excl-GST value = PRODDOCVALUE
statement: In ERP Retail Sales and Retail Returns, PRODDOCVALUE is the value excluding GST. PRODASSESSABLEVALUE INCLUDES GST (MRP minus discount), despite its name.
evidence: PRODDOCVALUE + GST = PRODASSESSABLEVALUE on every product line of the sample

title: Domestic excl-GST value = Taxable
statement: In ERP Domestic Sales and Returns, Taxable is the value excluding GST; Net Amount INCLUDES GST. Where Taxable is blank, the value is Net Amount minus Total Tax, marked DERIVED.
evidence: Taxable + Total Tax = Net Amount on 100% of 5,042 lines; 209 lines blank

title: Net sales = invoices minus returns
statement: Net sales are invoiced sales minus returns and credit notes, both excluding GST.

title: Every retail invoice is a real sale
statement: Every ERP Retail Sales invoice is a genuine D2C, marketplace or own-store sale.

title: Retail channel comes from CONTACTNAME
statement: The sales channel of a retail invoice or return is taken from CONTACTNAME. CHANNELNAME is the billing location and payment mode is not used for the channel.
evidence: 28 CONTACTNAME values map cleanly; all COD and Snapmint lines are Shopify_Customer

title: Exports go through Dileep at cost
statement: Exports are routed through Dileep group entities and billed to them cost-to-cost, with no profit. This covers the Dileep group accounts in Domestic Sales and the bare 'Dileep Essentials Pvt Ltd' contact on retail invoices. Low-value bills on these accounts are at cost price.

title: FBA contacts are Amazon customer orders
statement: Retail invoices with an FBA-named contact (e.g. 'Dileep Essentials Pvt Ltd FBA DED4') are Amazon customer orders fulfilled from that FBA warehouse.

title: Every retail return is a customer return
statement: Every ERP Retail Return is a genuine customer return. An FBA-named contact means the return was received back at that FBA warehouse.

title: Only true B2B invoices are final
statement: In Domestic Sales only outright B2B invoices are final. Franchise stores, SIS (shop-in-shop) and quick-commerce partners are supplied sale-or-return and send back unsold stock.
applies_to: Partner types B2B_CUSTOMER, FRANCHISE_PARTNER, SIS_PARTNER, QUICK_COMMERCE_PARTNER
evidence: Partner billing names to be supplied (gap G-004)

title: Person names in Domestic files are employees
statement: Any person's name in Domestic Sales or Returns is a company employee taking stock to exhibitions and bringing it back. Any domestic name not on the business-account list is treated as an employee; each load reports names classified this way.

title: What domestic returns contain
statement: Domestic Sale Returns contain B2B returns, unsold stock back from sale-or-return partners (Kiranakart Technologies = Blinkit), employee exhibition returns and stock from closed own stores.

title: Non-factory PO counterparties are return-inwards
statement: The Pending PO report also contains return invoices raised by companies and own stores sending stock back. Any counterparty not on the factory list is a return-inward, not a purchase.
evidence: Factory list to be supplied (gap G-005)

title: Only Trading items are sellable SKUs
statement: Only items of type Trading are sellable SKUs. Packaging, Accessory and Stores & Consumables items are kept but excluded from SKU analysis.

title: The Final Master defines current SKUs
statement: Sheet1 of the Ellementry Final Master lists the SKUs: Continued = currently sold, Discontinued = no longer sold. It is updated whenever something changes, so a fresh copy is taken with every data pull. Its stock columns are a stale copy and are never used.

title: Bagru warehouse naming
statement: ERP location '08 Jaipur Branch' is the Bagru warehouse; the head office is also in Bagru. The bare contact 'Dileep Essentials Pvt Ltd' on transfers is the same warehouse.
evidence: Bare name uses JPR/ document prefixes and is billed at 08 Jaipur Branch

title: WMS dispatch is B2C from Bagru
statement: The WMS dispatch export holds B2C orders only, all dispatched from the Bagru warehouse.

title: Blinkit DELIVERED = sold
statement: In the Blinkit sales export only DELIVERED orders count as sold. Blinkit returns come in a separate sheet.

title: FBA locations hold our stock
statement: Amazon FBA locations are Amazon warehouses holding Ellementry's own stock.

title: Prototype period and cut-off
statement: The prototype covers business dates 1 Apr 2025 to 15 Sep 2026. Rows after the cut-off are excluded in staging; raw keeps everything.

title: Stock history cannot be re-pulled
statement: Only the current day's stock snapshot can be exported; past days cannot. Stock history exists only from the day snapshots start being saved.

title: Stock at sale-or-return partners is still ours
statement: Goods sent to franchise, SIS and quick-commerce partners remain Ellementry stock at the partner's location until they sell through or come back.
applies_to: fact_stock_movement CONSIGNMENT_* movements; partner consignment locations
evidence: Proposed in Target Data Model v2, approved 1 Oct 2026

title: Two dates for a domestic return
statement: For domestic returns, the credit-note date (BILLDATE) is the date for net sales; the goods-receipt dates (RTNFROMCUSTDT, one per receipt) are the dates for stock. One credit note can cover several receipts.
evidence: Credit note of 29-Oct-2025 covered receipts of 22-Nov-2024 and 22-Jan-2025

title: Platform sell-out is demand, not revenue
statement: Quick-commerce consumer sales reported by the platforms measure demand. Company revenue is the ERP invoice. The two are never added together.

title: Each location counted once
statement: Where two systems report stock for the same location, the location's inventory system of record is used and the difference is reported, never summed.
evidence: ERP '27 Blinkit - Pune P2' and Blinkit 'Pune P2 - Feeder' report the same stock

title: Date formats are declared, never guessed
statement: Every source declares its date format. WMS dates are month/day; ERP text dates are day/month.

title: Unmatched values go to Unknown
statement: A value that does not match a dimension maps to the Unknown member (key -1) and is counted by a check; it is never dropped.

title: Agent outputs are stored
statement: Every forecast, recommendation and alert an agent produces is stored with the human decision taken on it.
evidence: Approved with Target Data Model v2

title: Employee exhibition stock stays ours
statement: Stock taken by employees for exhibitions is moved, in stock terms, to the 'With employees (exhibitions)' location and back; it is never revenue.

title: Snapshot files need their export date
statement: Snapshot, state and master exports carry no reliable date of their own; the export date is given at load time and checked against any date inside the file.
evidence: PO file named '12_09' contained dates up to 24 Sep
